facts.statement: Players with accounts in good standing could buy pre-paid Station Cash retail game cards at participating retailers and redeem them during the promotion for double their value in Station Cash.
facts.quote: purchase any pre-paid Station Cash retail game card at any of our participating retailers. Redeem that card during the promotional period for DOUBLE its value

facts.statement: Cards had to be redeemed between Friday, December 24 at 12 p.m. PDT and Monday, December 27 at 12 a.m. PDT to get the doubled value.
facts.quote: The cards MUST be redeemed between Friday, December 24th at 12p.m. PDT and Monday, December 27th at 12a.m. PDT

article_summaries.title: Double Station Cash Stocking Stuffer
article_summaries.summary: A limited-time holiday promotion (captured Dec 2010) in which pre-paid Station Cash retail game cards, bought at participating retailers, are worth double their value in Station Cash when redeemed during a set window. The page gives the redemption window and exclusions but no exact posting date (it says 'Posted 2 days, 17 hours ago' relative to capture).
